meta.coverage_horizon_note: coverage_near_term scales an intervention's shaded_area_m2 by its canopy_fraction_year5 when that field is present in costs.yml, so a tree planted for the 2026 event is credited with the canopy it actually has at year five, not the canopy it will have at maturity_years. interventions without a canopy_fraction_year5 field, such as the sail and the awning, reach full shaded_area_m2 immediately so coverage_near_term equals coverage_mature for them. path is the near_term_2026 horizon and is the honest number for the 2026 tournament. path_mature is the same greedy allocation logic run against full mature canopy and represents the long term legacy value of the same spend, not what the tournament itself will see.
